name: Verify Apteva contract and source
script:
set -euo pipefail
test "${APTEVA_PROTOCOL:-}" = "apteva.build/v1"
test -n "${APTEVA_TARGET_KIND:-}"

export APTEVA_SOURCE_DIR="$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR"
if [[ "${APTEVA_SOURCE_MODE:-repository}" = "bundle" ]]; then
  required=(APTEVA_SOURCE_URL APTEVA_SOURCE_SHA256 APTEVA_SOURCE_SIZE APTEVA_SOURCE_FORMAT)
  for name in "${required[@]}"; do
    test -n "${!name:-}" || { echo "missing required variable: $name" >&2; exit 1; }
  done
  test "$APTEVA_SOURCE_FORMAT" = "zip-v1"
  capsule="$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/apteva-source.zip"
  export APTEVA_SOURCE_DIR="$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/apteva-source"
  mkdir -p "$APTEVA_SOURCE_DIR"
  curl --fail --location --retry 3 --output "$capsule" "$APTEVA_SOURCE_URL"
  test "$(stat -f '%z' "$capsule")" = "$APTEVA_SOURCE_SIZE"
  test "$(shasum -a 256 "$capsule" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$APTEVA_SOURCE_SHA256"
  unzip -q "$capsule" -d "$APTEVA_SOURCE_DIR"
fi
echo "APTEVA_CAPSULE_DIR=$APTEVA_SOURCE_DIR" >> "$APTEVA_ENV_FILE"
echo "APTEVA_SOURCE_DIR=$APTEVA_SOURCE_DIR" >> "$APTEVA_ENV_FILE"

name: Decode mobile target
script:
set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY' >> "$APTEVA_ENV_FILE"
import base64
import json
import os

spec = json.loads(base64.b64decode(os.environ["APTEVA_BUILD_SPEC_B64"], validate=True))
target = json.loads(spec.get("target_config_json") or "{}")
values = {
    "APTEVA_MODULE": target.get("module", "app").strip(":"),
    "APTEVA_VARIANT": target.get("variant", "release"),
    "APTEVA_PACKAGE_NAME": target.get("package_name", ""),
    "APTEVA_VERSION_CODE": str(target.get("version_code", "")),
    "APTEVA_BUNDLE_ID": target.get("bundle_id", ""),
    "APTEVA_VERSION_NAME": str(target.get("version_name", "1.0.0")),
    "APTEVA_BUILD_NUMBER": str(target.get("build_number", "1")),
    "APTEVA_XCODE_PROJECT": target.get("project_path", ""),
    "APTEVA_XCODE_WORKSPACE": target.get("workspace_path", ""),
    "APTEVA_XCODE_SCHEME": target.get("scheme", ""),
    "APTEVA_CONFIGURATION": target.get("configuration", "Release"),
}
for key, value in values.items():
    value = str(value)
    if "\n" in value or "\r" in value:
        raise ValueError(f"{key} contains a newline")
    print(f"{key}={value}")
PY

name: Prepare source pipeline and verify toolchains
Build mobile artifact
script:
set -euo pipefail
output="$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/apteva-output"
mkdir -p "$output"
cd "${APTEVA_NATIVE_BUILD_DIR:-$APTEVA_SOURCE_DIR}"
extension="ipa"
if [[ "$APTEVA_TARGET_KIND" = "macos" ]]; then extension="pkg"; fi
if [[ "$APTEVA_TARGET_KIND" = "android" ]]; then extension="aab"; fi
primary="${APTEVA_OUTPUT_PRIMARY:-app.$extension}"
mkdir -p "$output/$(dirname "$primary")"
export DEPLOY_SOURCE_DIR="$APTEVA_SOURCE_DIR"
export DEPLOY_ARTIFACT_DIR="$output"

if [[ -n "${APTEVA_BUILD_CMD:-}" ]]; then
  sh -c "$APTEVA_BUILD_CMD"
elif [[ "$APTEVA_TARGET_KIND" = "ios" || "$APTEVA_TARGET_KIND" = "macos" ]]; then
  test -n "${APTEVA_BUNDLE_ID:-}"
  apple_platform="iOS"
  profile_type="IOS_APP_STORE"
  extension="ipa"
  if [[ "$APTEVA_TARGET_KIND" = "macos" ]]; then
    apple_platform="macOS"
    profile_type="MAC_APP_STORE"
    extension="pkg"
  fi
  if [[ -f project.yml ]] && \
    [[ ! -d "${APTEVA_XCODE_PROJECT:-}" && ! -d "${APTEVA_XCODE_WORKSPACE:-}" ]] && \
    ! find . -maxdepth 2 \( -name '*.xcodeproj' -o -name '*.xcworkspace' \) -print -quit | grep -q .; then
    # Use the same release on every runner, including machines with
    # an unrelated XcodeGen already on PATH. Keep its bundled presets.
    xcodegen_version="2.46.0"
    xcodegen_sha256="4d9e34b62172d645eed6457cac13fc222569974098ef4ee9c3368bedf0196806"
    tools="$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/apteva-tools/xcodegen-$xcodegen_version"
    mkdir -p "$tools"
    echo "Installing XcodeGen $xcodegen_version for project.yml"
    if ! curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
      --output "$tools/xcodegen.zip" \
      "https://github.com/yonaskolb/XcodeGen/releases/download/$xcodegen_version/xcodegen.zip"; then
      echo "XcodeGen $xcodegen_version installation failed: download failed" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    if ! printf '%s  %s\n' "$xcodegen_sha256" "$tools/xcodegen.zip" | shasum -a 256 -c -; then
      echo "XcodeGen $xcodegen_version installation failed: checksum mismatch" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    if ! unzip -q -o "$tools/xcodegen.zip" -d "$tools"; then
      echo "XcodeGen $xcodegen_version installation failed: extraction failed" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    xcodegen="$tools/xcodegen/bin/xcodegen"
    if ! installed_version="$("$xcodegen" --version)"; then
      echo "XcodeGen $xcodegen_version installation failed: binary cannot run" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "$installed_version"
    if [[ "$installed_version" != "Version: $xcodegen_version" ]]; then
      echo "XcodeGen installation failed: expected $xcodegen_version, got $installed_version" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    if ! "$xcodegen" generate; then
      echo "XcodeGen $xcodegen_version failed to generate project.yml" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  fi
  if [[ -z "${APTEVA_XCODE_SCHEME:-}" ]]; then
    echo "target_config_json.scheme is required" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  input=()
  if [[ -n "${APTEVA_XCODE_WORKSPACE:-}" ]]; then
    input=(-workspace "$APTEVA_XCODE_WORKSPACE")
  elif [[ -n "${APTEVA_XCODE_PROJECT:-}" ]]; then
    input=(-project "$APTEVA_XCODE_PROJECT")
  else
    workspace="$(find . -maxdepth 2 -name '*.xcworkspace' -print -quit)"
    project="$(find . -maxdepth 2 -name '*.xcodeproj' -print -quit)"
    if [[ -n "$workspace" ]]; then
      input=(-workspace "$workspace")
    elif [[ -n "$project" ]]; then
      input=(-project "$project")
    else
      echo "no Xcode project or workspace found" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  fi

  keychain initialize
  python3 "$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/scripts/install_managed_signing.py"
  xcode-project use-profiles --profile "$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/apteva-signing/profile.mobileprovision"
  archive="$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/apteva.xcarchive"
  ipa_dir="$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/apteva-ipa"
  xcodebuild "${input[@]}" \
    -scheme "$APTEVA_XCODE_SCHEME" \
    -configuration "$APTEVA_CONFIGURATION" \
    -destination "generic/platform=$apple_platform" \
    -archivePath "$archive" \
    MARKETING_VERSION="$APTEVA_VERSION_NAME" \
    CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION="$APTEVA_BUILD_NUMBER" \
    archive
  xcodebuild -exportArchive \
    -archivePath "$archive" \
    -exportPath "$ipa_dir" \
    -exportOptionsPlist "$HOME/export_options.plist"
  artifact="$(find "$ipa_dir" -name "*.$extension" -print -quit)"
  test -n "$artifact" || { echo "Xcode export produced no .$extension" >&2; exit 1; }
  cp "$artifact" "$output/$primary"
elif [[ "$APTEVA_TARGET_KIND" = "android" ]]; then
  test -n "${APTEVA_PACKAGE_NAME:-}"
  chmod +x ./gradlew
  variant_task="$(printf '%s' "$APTEVA_VARIANT" | awk '{ print toupper(substr($0, 1, 1)) substr($0, 2) }')"
  task=":${APTEVA_MODULE}:bundle${variant_task}"
  args=("$task" --console=plain --no-daemon)
  if [[ -n "${APTEVA_VERSION_CODE:-}" || -n "${APTEVA_VERSION_NAME:-}" ]]; then
    cat > "$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/apteva-mobile-version.gradle" <<'GRADLE'
allprojects { targetProject ->
    targetProject.plugins.withId("com.android.application") {
        def androidExt = targetProject.extensions.findByName("android")
        if (androidExt != null) {
            def code = System.getenv("APTEVA_VERSION_CODE")
            def name = System.getenv("APTEVA_VERSION_NAME")
            if (code != null && !code.isEmpty()) androidExt.defaultConfig.versionCode = Integer.parseInt(code)
            if (name != null && !name.isEmpty()) androidExt.defaultConfig.versionName = name
        }
    }
}
GRADLE
    args+=(--init-script "$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/apteva-mobile-version.gradle")
  fi
  ./gradlew "${args[@]}"
  cp "$(find . -path '*/outputs/bundle/*' -name '*.aab' -print -quit)" "$output/$primary"
else
  echo "unsupported APTEVA_TARGET_KIND=$APTEVA_TARGET_KIND" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "$APTEVA_TARGET_KIND" = "android" ]]; then
  test "${APTEVA_SIGNING_CONTRACT:-}" = "apteva.mobile-signing/v1" || {
    echo "unsupported or missing APTEVA_SIGNING_CONTRACT" >&2
    exit 1
  }
  required=(ANDROID_UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_BASE64 ANDROID_UPLOAD_KEY_ALIAS ANDROID_UPLOAD_STORE_PASSWORD ANDROID_UPLOAD_KEY_PASSWORD ANDROID_UPLOAD_CERT_SHA256)
  for name in "${required[@]}"; do
    test -n "${!name:-}" || { echo "missing required variable: $name" >&2; exit 1; }
  done
  keystore="$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/apteva-upload-key.p12"
  cleanup_android_keystore() { rm -f "$keystore"; }
  trap cleanup_android_keystore EXIT
  export APTEVA_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PATH="$keystore"
  umask 077
  python3 - <<'PY'
import base64
import os

with open(os.environ["APTEVA_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PATH"], "wb") as f:
    f.write(base64.b64decode(os.environ["ANDROID_UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_BASE64"], validate=True))
PY
  chmod 600 "$keystore"
  if ! unzip -Z1 "$output/$primary" | grep -Eiq '^META-INF/.*\.SF$'; then
    jarsigner \
      -keystore "$keystore" \
      -storetype PKCS12 \
      -storepass:env ANDROID_UPLOAD_STORE_PASSWORD \
      -keypass:env ANDROID_UPLOAD_KEY_PASSWORD \
      -sigalg SHA256withRSA \
      -digestalg SHA-256 \
      "$output/$primary" "$ANDROID_UPLOAD_KEY_ALIAS"
  fi
  jarsigner -verify -certs "$output/$primary"
  actual_fingerprint="$(keytool -printcert -jarfile "$output/$primary" -rfc | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | sed 's/^[^=]*=//; s/://g' | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')"
  expected_fingerprint="$(printf '%s' "$ANDROID_UPLOAD_CERT_SHA256" | sed 's/://g; s/ //g; s/-//g' | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')"
  if [[ -z "$actual_fingerprint" || "$actual_fingerprint" != "$expected_fingerprint" ]]; then
    echo "Android bundle signer does not match Deploy's managed upload certificate" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  printf 'APTEVA_ANDROID_SIGNER_SHA256=%s\n' "$actual_fingerprint" >> "$APTEVA_ENV_FILE"
  cleanup_android_keystore
  trap - EXIT
fi

name: Publish or package result
script:
set -euo pipefail
output="$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/apteva-output"
mode="${APTEVA_ARTIFACT_MODE:-file}"
channel="${APTEVA_STORE_CHANNEL:-internal}"

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os

platform = os.environ["APTEVA_TARGET_KIND"]
mode = os.environ.get("APTEVA_ARTIFACT_MODE", "file")
primary = os.environ["APTEVA_OUTPUT_PRIMARY"]
manifest = {
    "platform": platform,
    "primary": primary,
    "package_name": os.environ.get("APTEVA_PACKAGE_NAME", ""),
    "bundle_id": os.environ.get("APTEVA_BUNDLE_ID", ""),
    "version_name": os.environ.get("APTEVA_VERSION_NAME", ""),
    "build_number": os.environ.get("APTEVA_BUILD_NUMBER", ""),
    "version_code": os.environ.get("APTEVA_VERSION_CODE", ""),
    "certificate_sha256": os.environ.get("APTEVA_ANDROID_SIGNER_SHA256", ""),
    "signing_verified": bool(os.environ.get("APTEVA_ANDROID_SIGNER_SHA256", "")),
    "signing_contract": os.environ.get("APTEVA_SIGNING_CONTRACT", ""),
    "device_families": json.loads(os.environ.get("APTEVA_DEVICE_FAMILIES_JSON", "[]")),
}
with open(os.path.join(os.environ["APTEVA_BUILD_DIR"], "apteva-output", ".apteva-artifact.json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump(manifest, f, separators=(",", ":"))
PY
if [[ -n "${APTEVA_PIPELINE_RUNNER:-}" ]]; then
  "$APTEVA_PIPELINE_RUNNER" --cloud-pipeline finalize \
    --source "$APTEVA_CAPSULE_DIR" --artifact "$output"
fi
primary="$APTEVA_OUTPUT_PRIMARY"
if [[ "$mode" = "store_upload" && ( "$APTEVA_TARGET_KIND" = "ios" || "$APTEVA_TARGET_KIND" = "macos" ) ]]; then
  required=(APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_IDENTIFIER APP_STORE_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY)
  for name in "${required[@]}"; do
    test -n "${!name:-}" || { echo "missing required variable: $name" >&2; exit 1; }
  done
  key="$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/AuthKey_${APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_IDENTIFIER}.p8"
  printf '%s\n' "$APP_STORE_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$key"
  apple_extension="ipa"
  if [[ "$APTEVA_TARGET_KIND" = "macos" ]]; then apple_extension="pkg"; fi
  xcrun altool --upload-package "$output/$primary" \
    --api-key "$APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_IDENTIFIER" \
    --api-issuer "$APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID" \
    --p8-file-path "$key" \
    --output-format json
  rm -f "$key"
elif [[ "$mode" = "store_upload" && "$APTEVA_TARGET_KIND" = "android" ]]; then
  test -n "${GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_CREDENTIALS:-}"
  test -n "${APTEVA_VERSION_CODE:-}"
  fastlane supply \
    --json_key_data "$GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_CREDENTIALS" \
    --aab "$output/$primary" \
    --package_name "$APTEVA_PACKAGE_NAME" \
    --track "$channel"
fi

if [[ -n "${APTEVA_PIPELINE_RUNNER:-}" ]]; then
  "$APTEVA_PIPELINE_RUNNER" --cloud-pipeline verify \
    --source "$APTEVA_CAPSULE_DIR" --artifact "$output"
fi
if [[ "$mode" = "store_upload" ]]; then
  python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
path = os.path.join(os.environ["APTEVA_BUILD_DIR"], "apteva-output", ".apteva-artifact.json")
with open(path) as f:
    manifest = json.load(f)
apple = os.environ["APTEVA_TARGET_KIND"] in ("ios", "macos")
manifest.update(channel=os.environ.get("APTEVA_STORE_CHANNEL", ""),
                external_provider="app_store_connect" if apple else "google_play",
                external_status="uploaded_processing" if apple else "completed")
with open(path, "w") as f:
    json.dump(manifest, f, separators=(",", ":"))
PY
fi
cd "$output"
zip -qry "$APTEVA_BUILD_DIR/${APTEVA_ARTIFACT_NAME:-apteva-build}.zip" .
